title: Character Region Awareness for Text Detection
summary: CRAFT 预测字符区域与字符间 affinity，可把整行候选拆成字符组/词组。

mechanisms.name: Character Region Awareness for Text Detection — l10:2 route mechanism
mechanisms.description: CRAFT 预测字符区域与字符间 affinity，可把整行候选拆成字符组/词组。
mechanisms.limitations: 只做检测/分组；相邻词仍可能错误粘连，也没有 lexical identity。
